message.meshcut.grab.0: Fragment grabbed, Scroll to adjust distance
message.meshcut.grab.3: Find stable footing; you cannot pull the fragment you stand on
message.meshcut.connections.result: Blue: selected piece;Orange: contacts %s connected neighbours
message.meshcut.connections.unknown: Blue: selected piece;Orange: contacts %s known neighbours; some unloaded
tooltip.meshcut.laser_controls: Right-click to fire;Ctrl + scroll to adjust radius
tooltip.meshcut.laser_dye: Gun in offhand + dye in main hand: right-click to dye
tooltip.meshcut.saber_controls: Right-click to toggle; cuts settle automatically; Ctrl + scroll adjusts length
tooltip.meshcut.saber_controls_hold: Hold right-click to activate; release to switch off; Ctrl + scroll adjusts length
tooltip.meshcut.saber_connections: Hold %s to view connections: blue fragment, orange contacts
tooltip.meshcut.saber_dye: Saber in offhand + dye in main hand: right-click to dye
tooltip.meshcut.saber_gestures: Press %s for a swing;Hold %s and move the mouse to reposition
meshcut.config.physics.maxEntries.toolti: Number of unique precise mimic collider entries before coarse collision is used. Restart the game to rebuild existing colliders.
meshcut.config.cutting.tryAllRegionOrder: Try all six greedy region merging orders. More CPU work; normally leave disabled.
meshcut.config.cutting.settlementTicks.t: Ticks between automatic lightsaber cut settlements (20 ticks = one second).
meshcut.config.diagnostics.enabled.toolt: Enable detailed physics and cut timing logs.
meshcut.config.debris.maxVolume.tooltip: A piece cut off with less material than this, in blocks, disappears after a while (0 keeps all).
meshcut.config.debris.lifetimeSeconds.to: How long such a piece lasts, in seconds.
meshcut.config.debris.expireMinutes.tool: Every sub-level a cut makes poofs away this many minutes after it was made (0 keeps them). Pieces interacted with by players are preserved.
meshcut.config.surge.maxPieces.tooltip: When more pieces than this are made within the window, the smallest are burnt up (0 keeps all).
meshcut.config.surge.windowSeconds.toolt: The window, in seconds, in which the pieces are counted.
meshcut.config.surge.maxVolume.tooltip: A piece with at least this much material, in blocks, is never burnt up.
meshcut.config.woodBurning.maxVolume.too: Detached all-wood cut fragments up to this volume burn away; 0 disables.
meshcut.config.woodBurning.seconds.toolt: Seconds of sparks and smoke before a wooden fragment disappears.
meshcut.config.grab.maxForce.tooltip: The most force a player holding a cut piece by hand can pull it with (as Create Aeronautics' handles).
meshcut.config.lightsaber.activation.too: HOLD: hold use to keep the blade lit. TOGGLE: click use to switch on/off.
meshcut.config.rendering.vbo.tooltip: Cache cut entity and special block-entity model geometry in GPU vertex buffers. Cut glow always uses shared batching.
